newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank shares fall after profit outlook.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank shares fall after profit outlook.

text.p: Shares in Commerzbank AG fell more than one percent in pre-bourse trade on Tuesday after the bank revealed a lower-than-expected net profit for 1996.
The shares were quoted down 0.59 marks or 1.35 percent at 43.10 marks in electronic dealing on the IBIS system at 0815 GMT.

Commerzbank said it was keeping its dividend unchanged at 1.35 marks per five-mark share as expected but its net profit of roughly 1.19 billion marks, up 22 percent from 1995, was below analysts' forecasts for 1.3 billion marks.
The bank's shares underperformed the IBIS DAX index which was down 6.33 points or 0.21 percent at 2,986.22.
